caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with four turned legs connected by curved stretchers that meet at a central sphere near the floor. The table features three drawers on the front side, each with a brass-colored keyhole escutcheon. The front edge of the apron is shaped with decorative curves and points. The tabletop has a darker blue or greenish central section, bordered by a lighter, brown wooden frame. Shadows beneath the table suggest a light source from the upper right. The table is rendered in shades of brown, gold, and blue/green, and is bordered by a double-lined rectangular frame in red and blue. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Lowboy
